2.152.22
ChartLegend.Style
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.Style element specifies the style properties for a ChartLegend. This element is
optional. This element is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.Style element.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
